grammar distinctions required by LRN: T succession must remain distinct from K transformation/dependence; LRN04 r8 and LRN05 r7 are ordering without a licensed state-update edge.
P_in intervention and P_out probe/read must remain directional; LRN03-LRN06 use both directions in the same claim.
Q criterion orientation must remain distinct from generic comparison/difference. LRN01 neurological-group dissociation is not the same relation as its classification-accuracy Q.
C admissibility/resource constraint must remain distinct from ordinary conditions or numerical parameters; LRN02 discount/learning-rate parameters are not C, while LRN03 matched activity time is.
Pi must remain evidence-based individuation rather than lexical grouping/boundary language; only LRN06 licenses Pi in this lane.
rho/O must allow nonterminal traces, but LRN exposes an orientation issue between incoming informational traces and P_out readout traces.
Object-level system relations must be distinguished from epistemic/model-fitting relations that infer X from O.

potential threats to Grammar v0.description: Four LRN claims contain frozen epistemic/estimation relations from observations to latent structures that v0 does not type.
Incoming informational O-like traces are not explicit in the merged Lean read/query observation relation.
LRN01's double dissociation requires a condition-indexed comparison relation not licensed by its Q node.
Conservative reverse projection avoids treating all learning as K, all grouping as Pi, or all numeric parameters as C; no failure here requires such overreach.

counterexample_assessment.interpretation: These are counterexamples to Grammar v0 as a complete representation of every frozen ClaimIR relation, chiefly because v0 lacks an explicit epistemic/estimation layer (O -> latent X) and, in LRN01, a generic condition-indexed comparison layer. They are not counterexamples to the internal consistency of the Lean skeleton or to the usefulness of the core object-level X/K/T/P/Q/C/Pi/rho subgrammar.
